$comment: Graphics presets (ARCHITECTURE.md §6, the settings row; docs/DEV_TOOLS.md, Graphics presets). Settings → Graphics's Preset slider runs through `presets` in order, cheapest first; moving it applies one, and any graphics setting changed by hand shows Custom. Each preset sets every field of the fixed vocabulary the loader knows (client/src/ui/graphicsPresets.ts `PRESET_FIELDS`), by name: `renderScale` one of shared/render/upscale.json's scales and `upscaler` one of its upscalers, `water` a water tier (low/medium/high), `shadows` and `torchShadows` off/low/high, `shafts` and `clouds` off/low/high, `distanceM`/`pixelError`/`memoryMb` the detail sliders (a phone clamps them to its ranges). The cuts are ordered by GPU time saved per beauty lost, from the measured costs (docs/DEV_TOOLS.md, Cost profile and Water cost): the render scale first, then water High → Medium, torch shadows, sun shadows, light shafts, clouds, and the draw distance last; refraction and caustics (water Medium) are kept down to Medium. `default` names the preset a new player starts on, per device.
